business_problem: Gerdau needed a better way to support streaming industrial analytics and self-service data for steel production because the company needed faster, cheaper, and more scalable processing for manufacturing, sustainability, and business data spread across multiple teams.
solution_summary: Gerdau uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support streaming industrial analytics and self-service data for steel production. The implementation replaced a legacy state where the company needed faster, cheaper, and more scalable processing for manufacturing, sustainability, and business data spread across multiple teams. Mill operations data and streaming manufacturing data move through production data pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog and Delta Sharing governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Agent Bricks operationalizes models, agents, and analytics that deliver industrial analytics and streaming data products.
business_outcome: Gerdau improved streaming industrial analytics and self-service data for steel production with measurable results including 40% shaping global infrastructure with ironclad manufacturing, 80% cost reduction for data processing, and 300 in new developments for streaming solutions, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
